parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to unzip an already-extracted helloExtension directory, then navigated to chrome://extensions, enabled Developer mode, clicked Load unpacked, opened file picker to Desktop, but never completed selecting the folder. Spent 50 turns cycling between terminal and extensions page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to chrome:// URLs, open terminal and run shell commands, enable Developer mode on extensions page, interact with file picker dialog
metadata.failure_analysis: Model was confused by instruction to 'unzip' an already-extracted directory. After reaching the file picker in 'Load unpacked' flow, it could not complete the selection of the helloExtension folder and click Select.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original task to its simplest sub-task: navigating to chrome://extensions, which the model demonstrated it can do successfully
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://extensions. Evaluator uses active_url_from_accessTree to get current URL and is_expected_url_pattern_match to verify it matches the extensions page pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is exactly the state needed to verify navigation to the extensions page.
The goto_prefix 'chrome://' is appropriate for internal Chrome pages.
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly receives the rules dict directly (framework returns config['rules'] for type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get the pattern list.
The regex pattern 'chrome://extensions.*' correctly matches chrome://extensions and any subpath (e.g., chrome://extensions/?id=xxx).
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (navigate to extensions management page) is fully verified by checking the active URL.
No postconfig needed - the URL state persists after navigation.
